teaser: "You didn't have to do this," someone says, looking at the full fridge, the folded laundry, the appointment already booked. You are a 6, and the four letters sitting inside that path are ISFJ. The life path asks for care that holds a house together; the type supplies hands that already know how to do it without being asked. What is particular here is how little daylight sits between what one wants to carry and what the other has already picked up. Watch for the moment nobody is surprised at what you've taken on, only at how long before you mentioned needing anything back.
